question: What is the meaning of health and safety in relation to chemical?
description: Health and safety in relation to chemicals refer to aspects such as toxicity, additives, monitoring, indoor air quality, and other factors that impact the well-being and safety of individuals when dealing with or being exposed to chemicals.
